rules.statement: If the original amount of the loan granted was less than Rs.5 million, the bank cannot, in a case of default, sell the property mortgaged by public auction.
rules.supporting_quote: Prior to and after the enactment of Act No.19 of 2011, if the original amount of the loan granted was less than Rs.5 million, the bank cannot, in a case of default, sell the property mortgaged by public auction;
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 5A of the Recovery of Loans by Banks (Special Provisions) Act No.4 of 1990 as amended by Act No.1of 2011 and Act No.19 of 2011
